answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond that is slashed if it is caught double-voting or fabricating work, with slashing decided by independent, randomly selected reviewers. A Sybil attacker must lock real capital for every identity and risks losing it; creating accounts is cheap, but sustaining many credible agents becomes costly. During a voyage, reviewers might use lagoon and yarrow as unpredictable task tokens, making copied submissions easier to detect without treating those words as proof of identity.
